dedupe_keys.name: dataset and code for a case study of space time performance comparison of wind turbines on a wind farm

description: The authors deposit code and a partial dataset for comparing turbine performance over space and time at a wind farm. Zenodo provides a public archive and reproducibility report under CC BY 4.0. The own page identifies a 2021 Renewable Energy article and warns that one table’s numbers were generated with DSWE version 1.3.4; DSWE 1.5.1 can produce different results even when the L-BFGS-B optimisation setting is selected. The code may help modellers test wind-turbine power comparisons or benchmark changes in analysis versions. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this archived study workflow. A limitation is that only a partial dataset is shared, and the page does not identify the farm, observation period or full variable schema. Version-dependent output should not be treated as evidence of turbine degradation without the original data and assumptions. The archive was not downloaded, no reproducibility report claim was recalculated and no code was run.
